reference_audit.interpretation: One paired initialization and the same original train/validation event streams. Only half the training initial-record orders change; per-example positions/lengths/labels and all hyperparameters stay matched. Both already-observed validation orders are development diagnostics, not fresh confirmation. Neither an augmentation gain nor a generic shared bottleneck establishes a semantic interface or isolated recurrent-write damage. Shared must beat independent controllers under the same ordinary augmentation before architectural escalation.
